questions.stemEn: A child has inappropriate laughing, hypotonia, delayed walking and speech, with a characteristic facial picture. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: Inappropriate laughter مع severe speech/developmental delay وhypotonia هي clues التي يستخدمها المصدر لـAngelman syndrome.
questions.reasoningEn: The source phenotype is most consistent with Angelman syndrome.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Williams يرتبط social personality وhypercalcemia، Noonan بshort stature/cardiac features، وPrader-Willi بhypotonia ثم hyperphagia/obesity.
questions.clinicalPearl: Image phenotype matters here; preserve the original visual before publication.

image.captionEn: Original source facial image supports Angelman syndrome.

questions.stemEn: Which renal anomaly is most likely to be seen in Williams syndrome?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار horseshoe kidney ويذكر أن renal abnormalities في Williams متنوعة وتشمل ectopic/horseshoe kidney وrenal aplasia/hypoplasia. لذلك نحتفظ بالمفتاح لكن نراجع صيغة 'most likely'.
questions.reasoningEn: The source lists horseshoe kidney among structural renal abnormalities in Williams syndrome and selects it from the given options.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر يذكر أن renal aplasia/hypoplasia قد تحدث أيضًا، لذلك السؤال لا يعني أنها مستحيلة؛ الاختيار هو الأفضل بين الخيارات وفق المصدر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Williams syndrome can include renal/urinary tract abnormalities in addition to cardiovascular disease.

questions.stemEn: A child has hypercalcemia and a cocktail-party personality, consistent with Williams syndrome. What cardiac lesion is most likely associated?
questions.explanationAr: Hypercalcemia + outgoing/cocktail-party phenotype يوجه إلى Williams syndrome، والمصدر يختار supravalvular aortic stenosis كassociation قلبية أساسية.
questions.reasoningEn: Supravalvular aortic stenosis is a classic cardiovascular association of Williams syndrome.
questions.clinicalPearl: Williams syndrome also warrants blood-pressure and vascular assessment because arteriopathy may extend beyond the aortic root.

tts.text: A child has hypercalcemia and a cocktail-party personality, consistent with Williams syndrome. What cardiac lesion is most likely associated? A. Supravalvular aortic stenosis.

questions.stemEn: A boy with pectus excavatum is shown in a picture consistent with Marfan syndrome. What is the most common associated heart lesion?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار mitral valve prolapse من الخيارين. لأن صورة Marfan جزء من التشخيص ولأن aortic root disease أيضًا مهمة جدًا في Marfan، نحفظ مفتاح المصدر ونطلب تحققًا من صيغة 'most common'.
questions.reasoningEn: The recalled exam key selects mitral valve prolapse from the two listed options.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Aortic stenosis ليس association الكلاسيكية في Marfan؛ لكن aortic root dilatation/dissection هو الخطر القلبي المهم سريريًا.
questions.clinicalPearl: Marfan surveillance focuses heavily on the aortic root even when MVP is present.

questions.stemEn: A 13-year-old boy has typical features of Marfan syndrome. What is the mode of inheritance?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار autosomal dominant لMarfan syndrome.
questions.reasoningEn: Marfan syndrome due to FBN1 variants follows an autosomal dominant inheritance pattern in the source.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: الأنماط X-linked وautosomal recessive لا تطابق Marfan في هذا السؤال.
questions.clinicalPearl: A de novo variant can occur even with a negative family history.

questions.stemEn: A mutation in the FBN1 gene is associated with which syndrome?
questions.explanationAr: FBN1 encodes fibrillin-1، والمصدر يربطه بـMarfan syndrome.
questions.reasoningEn: The source identifies FBN1 mutation with Marfan syndrome.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Homocystinuria وDuchenne muscular dystrophy لهما أسباب جينية مختلفة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Phenotypic overlap with homocystinuria can occur, but the molecular defect differs.

questions.stemEn: A 13-year-old volleyball player is tall, has pectus excavatum and a heart murmur. Why should he be restricted from contact sports?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يربط Marfan syndrome بخطر aortic dissection، ويذكر أن vigorous exercise قد يثير dissection عند بعض المرضى.
questions.reasoningEn: Aortic disease is a major life-threatening concern in Marfan syndrome and drives exercise restrictions.
questions.clinicalPearl: Sports advice should ultimately be individualized to aortic dimensions, valve disease and current cardiology guidance.

tts.text: A thirteen-year-old volleyball player is tall, has pectus excavatum and a heart murmur. Why should he be restricted from contact sports? A. Risk of aortic dissection.

questions.stemEn: A child has the hand feature shown in the provided picture, consistent with Marfan syndrome. Which complication is he at risk for?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار aortic rupture. سريريًا يُستخدم غالبًا تعبير aortic root dilatation/dissection/rupture كالمضاعفة الخطرة؛ لذلك نحافظ على لفظ المصدر ونضع السؤال للمراجعة.
questions.reasoningEn: The recalled source uses 'aortic rupture' as the life-threatening aortic complication associated with Marfan syndrome.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Aortic stenosis وtricuspid regurgitation ليست المضاعفات الكلاسيكية المقصودة هنا.
questions.clinicalPearl: Use precise aortic terminology during verification; the source wording is preserved as recalled.
